name: Ghostex
description: Ghostex cross-platform GPUI workarea and sessions UI: Rust gxserver, zmx/wmx session daemons, Rust chat and sidebar cores, native GPUI desktop and web renderers, and a React Native mobile app.
build_health_command: bun run typecheck && bun run desktop:typecheck && (cd server && cargo check) && (cd apps/desktop && cargo check)
lint_command: (cd server && cargo clippy) && (cd apps/desktop && cargo clippy)
__dev_command_note: AGENTS.md: never run `bun run start` (it restarts the user's app) unless the user asks. `bun run start:server` is allowed without asking on macOS to prove gxserver changes. Chat and sidebar changes are proven in the GPUI web build (`bun run web:dev` on :4174).

agent_team.delegation: Inside Ghostex, delegate to other agent sessions through the upstream `ghostex agents` CLI (read `ghostex agents --help` first). Role files live in .claude/agents/.

claude.entry: Claude Code with the ghostex-core subagents (.claude/agents) and /opsx:* commands

folders.purpose: Active project — all KBD operations target this directory
